cases.title: Tenant administrator uses only persisted XianGuanJia configuration
cases.user_goal: Manage every XianGuanJia business setting from the admin page without environment-variable or credential-reference compatibility.
preconditions: The generic database encryption key is available.
steps: Open the tenant XianGuanJia configuration page.
Inspect enabled state, endpoint, masked AppKey, blank AppSecret replacement input, write switch, job switch, and sync parameters.
Restart or use the backend without any XGJ environment variables.
expected_results: Configuration is resolved only from the current tenant application row.
AppSecret is never returned.
Missing credentials cannot remain enabled.
Write operations remain disabled until explicitly enabled.
boundary_cases: Invalid base URL cannot be enabled.
Cross-tenant configuration reads and updates are denied.
The removed credential_reference column is absent.

cases.title: Scheduled read synchronization preserves business data integrity
cases.user_goal: Synchronize authorized shop resources without losing existing data.
preconditions: Tenant 1 integration and job switches are enabled.
The real write switch is disabled.
steps: Observe scheduled read synchronization.
Inspect recent sync runs and current table counts.
Run schema, tenant, and orphan-relation checks.
expected_results: Successful shops continue syncing idempotently.
Business row counts do not decrease.
No missing-parent or cross-tenant relation is introduced.
boundary_cases: Third-party partial failures are recorded without deleting successful or historical data.

cases.title: Operations manager sees a responsive server-backed dashboard
cases.user_goal: Use the current server snapshot on desktop and mobile without prototype data.
preconditions: Local backend, admin frontend, and schedule center are running.
The browser has an authenticated tenant-1 session.
steps: Load the dashboard at 1440 CSS pixels.
Load the dashboard at 390 CSS pixels.
Wait for the server snapshot and inspect operational counts.
expected_results: Counts are derived from the backend snapshot.
No page-level horizontal overflow occurs.
Loading, ready, empty, and partial states remain distinct.
boundary_cases: Permission denial does not erase unrelated data.
One failed query does not replace the whole dashboard with zeros.

cases.title: Warehouse operator can review shipment inputs but cannot bypass server gates
cases.user_goal: Review waybill, device, and pending order before a server-authoritative shipment.
preconditions: Registered available devices and synchronized pending orders exist.
The persisted real-write switch is disabled.
steps: Open the shipping workbench.
Inspect device search and pending-order search.
Verify search support for receiver name, full phone, and order number.
Inspect the final confirmation state without submitting.
expected_results: OCR remains an editable draft.
Device and order are selected independently.
Complete customer verification fields appear only in authorized search results.
The real shipment button remains disabled while the write switch is off.
No optimistic shipment state is created.
boundary_cases: Missing waybill, device, order, rental period, permission, or write switch blocks submission.
Selecting an order does not overwrite the entered waybill.

cases.title: Tenant, permission, customer-data, and secret boundaries remain enforced
cases.user_goal: Prevent cross-tenant access and secret disclosure.
preconditions: Only tenant 1 has a fully configured enabled application.
steps: Inspect tenant-scoped application, shop, order, and raw-payload relations.
Inspect permission-gated management UI and API behavior.
Scan responses, logs, and frontend code for secret exposure.
expected_results: No cross-tenant or missing-parent relation exists.
Private customer data requires existing management permissions.
AppSecret and raw payload content are not returned in ordinary responses or logs.
boundary_cases: Missing permission returns a safe denial.
Frontend state cannot bypass backend permission or tenant checks.

cases.title: Schedule center remains accessible across theme, locale, keyboard, and touch states
cases.user_goal: Operate every route without losing focus or context.
steps: Switch light and dark theme.
Switch zh-CN and en locale.
Open mobile navigation, dialogs, drawers, account menu, and login overlay.
Exercise Escape and Tab or Shift+Tab.
expected_results: Preferences persist and labels update.
Overlays trap and restore focus.
Touch targets and reduced-motion behavior remain usable.
boundary_cases: Inaccessible actions are absent or disabled with a clear reason.
Route changes do not leave stale overlays or focus.
